title: RoadmapItem
description: A roadmap milestone or phase item for KeepMees

phase.description: Product/development phase (e.g. engine-foundation, product-system, vendor-readiness, commerce)

successCriteria.description: Criteria that define this milestone as complete

qualityGate.description: Specific check or approval required before declaring success

dependencies.description: IDs of milestones or packages that must complete first

unlocksNext.description: What becomes available after this milestone completes

coordinatorSyncRequired.description: True if Coordinator must review before this milestone closes
